quickAnswer.question: What vehicles does iWay Tourism offer for hire in Kanyakumari and Trivandrum?
quickAnswer.answer: iWay Tourism operates a fleet of Toyota Innova Crysta sedans, 12-seater, 14-seater, and 17-seater Tempo Travellers with pushback seats, and 26-seater mini buses. All vehicles are available for airport transfers from Trivandrum (TRV), local sightseeing, outstation trips, wedding transport, and corporate group travel across the Kanyakumari and Trivandrum districts.

bookingProcess.heading: How to Book a Vehicle with iWay Tourism

steps.title: Tell Us Your Requirements
steps.description: Fill out the enquiry form below or call us directly. Let us know your travel dates, pickup location (Marthandam, Nagercoil, Trivandrum, or anywhere in between), group size, and whether you need a one-way transfer, full-day rental, or multi-day booking.

steps.title: Receive a Custom Quote
steps.description: Within 2 hours during business hours, our operations team will confirm vehicle availability and send you an all-inclusive quote covering the vehicle, driver, fuel (within agreed km limits), tolls, and parking. No hidden charges.

steps.title: Confirm and Go
steps.description: Confirm your booking with a simple advance payment. On the day of travel, your assigned driver will arrive at the designated pickup point 15 minutes early. You will receive the driver's name, phone number, and vehicle registration via WhatsApp.

faqs.question: How far in advance should I book a Tempo Traveller in Marthandam?
faqs.answer: For weekday travel, 2–3 days advance booking is usually sufficient. For weekends, festival periods (Pongal, Onam, Christmas), and wedding season (April–June), we recommend booking at least 7–10 days ahead. Peak-season availability for 17-seater and 26-seater vehicles fills up fastest.

faqs.question: Does the rental price include fuel and tolls?
faqs.answer: Yes. All iWay Tourism vehicle quotes are all-inclusive — covering driver charges, fuel within the agreed kilometre limit, tolls, and parking. If you exceed the km limit on a multi-day trip, additional charges apply at a transparent per-km rate communicated upfront in the quote.

faqs.question: Can I book a one-way drop from Trivandrum Airport to Kanyakumari?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. The Trivandrum Airport (TRV) to Kanyakumari one-way transfer covers approximately 95 km and takes about 2 to 2.5 hours depending on traffic through Parasala and Nagercoil. We offer this transfer in Innova Crysta (up to 6 passengers) or Tempo Traveller (groups of 8+). Return trips from Kanyakumari to TRV are also available.

faqs.question: Are your drivers experienced with the Kanyakumari–Trivandrum route?
faqs.answer: All iWay drivers are locally based and have extensive experience with every major and minor route across the Kanyakumari and Trivandrum districts — including narrow hill roads to Thirparappu Falls, the Padmanabhapuram Palace approach from Thuckalay, and the coastal road to Vattakottai Fort. They also handle Trivandrum city traffic and airport terminal navigation daily.

faqs.question: Do you provide vehicles for weddings and functions?
faqs.answer: Yes. Wedding and function transport is one of our core services. We provide decorated vehicles for the wedding couple, Tempo Travellers for guest shuttles between venues, and mini buses for large wedding parties. We coordinate multi-vehicle logistics — from guest pickup points across Nagercoil and Marthandam to the wedding hall and back — as a single, managed booking.
